commit.message:
fix(runtime): read the freeze from the record, keep the journal append-only (0133)

What is frozen (examples and their concept tags, checks, the files they use)
is read from the branch's recorded tip by workPackage frozen, the journal's
refusals and the freeze gate; the working copy only for what the tip does not
hold, and the ledger where cratylus keeps it (0134). submit and update refuse
to widen outputs onto a frozen check's own files; define consults the freeze
and refuses while it cannot be read. The gate refuses any branch update that
changes or deletes a journal entry, from anyone, and reads the repository
from any work tree or the git directory of a push, refusing where it cannot.
